name: Hangzhou Cogeneration Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Cogeneration Group Co., Ltd. provides heat supply and power generation services in China. The company operates through the Thermal Power Business, Coal Business, and Others segments. It is also involved in coal, steam, electricity, and thermal power pipeline construction. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China. Hangzhou Cogeneration Group Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Hangzhou Energy Group Co., Ltd.
